tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool mineral white, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas that need to separate from ground. Used sparingly; most content sits directly on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground and surface. 15:1 on ground in light.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground: dates, roles, captions. 7:1 on ground in light. Not for text on layer colours.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between rows and sections. Decorative separation only, not a control border.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Figures in the ledger and list markers on ground.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, link underlines, the current marker. Never body text on ground in light (2:1).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill. 8:1 on gold.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px. Deliberately outside the green and gold family so it is never mistaken for decoration.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of inline code in prose.

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 'read the original' note on companion posts. A tint in light, a quiet raised surface in dark so it does not glare.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Text on note-bg.

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: Top layer of the stack (Agents). Text on it uses layer-ink-light.

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: Second layer of the stack (Models). Text on it uses layer-ink-light.

tokens.name: layer-3
tokens.usage: Third layer of the stack (Capacity). Text on it uses layer-ink-dark.

tokens.name: layer-4
tokens.usage: Foundation layer (Data). Also the contact band and code blocks. Text on it uses layer-ink-dark.

tokens.name: layer-ink-light
tokens.usage: Text on layer-1 and layer-2, in both themes.

tokens.name: layer-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Text on layer-3 and layer-4, in both themes.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: I help AI startups get agents out of the demo.
styles.usage: One per page. Fluid on the site: clamp(2.5rem, 1.2rem + 5.6vw, 5.25rem). Max 13 characters per line.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings in the left rail. Fluid down to 28px.

styles.name: layer-title
styles.usage: The name of a layer in the stack. Nowhere else.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Vertex AI Agent Builder, Gemini API
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons (weight 600), dates, roles, tool lists.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The post kind label only. The floor for text size.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Founders and engineering leaders bring me in for the hard middle of an AI build.
styles.usage: Hero paragraph and post summaries. Fluid down to 20px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A second agent grades the conversation against a rubric, with evidence for every score.
styles.usage: Default paragraph text on the home page.

styles.name: post
styles.sample: Discovery is the skill that separates a good Customer Engineer from a product catalog with a calendar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps inside a label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in the ledger; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs groups; post row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Column gap between the heading rail and content; between systems.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Below the hero; above the pager.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding at desktop. Fluid on the site: clamp(4.5rem, 3rem + 6vw, 8rem).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, the skip link.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The outer corners of the stack, code blocks, notes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the theme toggle.
